dashboard.label: Tableau de Bord Threat Hunting SSH via Fortigate
dashboard.description: Ce tableau de bord permet d’analyser le trafic SSH observé dans les logs Fortigate live. Il met en évidence les sources SSH actives, les destinations ciblées, les actions du pare-feu, les pics temporels, les connexions non autorisées, les activités hors horaires et les comportements pouvant indiquer une reconnaissance ou un accès distant suspect.

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | eval total_bytes=coalesce(tonumber(sentbyte),0)+coalesce(tonumber(rcvdbyte),0) | stats count as evenements_ssh dc(srcip) as sources_uniques dc(dstip) as destinations_uniques sum(total_bytes) as volume_octets | eval volume_Go=round(volume_octets/1024/1024/1024,2) | table evenements_ssh sources_uniques destinations_uniques volume_Go
index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-24h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | timechart span=1h count as evenements_ssh

chart.title: SSH par action firewall dans le temps

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-24h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | eval action_ssh=case( action="allowed","Autorisé", action="block" OR action="blocked","Bloqué", action="teardown","Fin de session", 1=1,"Autre" ) | timechart span=1h count by action_ssh

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | eval statut_action=case( action="allowed","autorise", action="block" OR action="blocked","non_autorise", action="teardown","fin_session", 1=1,"autre" ) | stats count(eval(statut_action="autorise")) as autorisees count(eval(statut_action="non_autorise")) as ssh_bloquees dc(dstip) as destinations_ssh by srcip | eval decisions=autorisees+ssh_bloquees | where decisions>=20 AND ssh_bloquees>=10 | eval ratio_non_autorise=round((ssh_bloquees/decisions)*100,2) | where ratio_non_autorise>=80 | eval score_priorite=round( (ratio_non_autorise*0.5) +(min(ssh_bloquees,100)*0.3) +(min(destinations_ssh,20)*1), 2 ) | sort - score_priorite | head 10 | table srcip score_priorite

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | where action="block" OR action="blocked" | stats count as connexions_ssh_bloquees dc(dstip) as destinations_ssh by srcip | where connexions_ssh_bloquees>=10 | sort - connexions_ssh_bloquees | head 10 | table srcip connexions_ssh_bloquees

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | where action="block" OR action="blocked" | stats count as tentatives_bloquees dc(srcip) as sources_uniques by dstip | where tentatives_bloquees>=10 | sort - tentatives_bloquees | head 10 | table dstip tentatives_bloquees

index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | where action="block" OR action="blocked" | eval heure=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | where heure<8 OR heure>18 | stats count as connexions_hors_horaires dc(dstip) as destinations_ssh by srcip | where connexions_hors_horaires>=10 | sort - connexions_hors_horaires | head 10 | table srcip connexions_hors_horaires

table.title: Score de risque SSH par IP source

search.query: index=fortigate sourcetype=fortigate_traffic earliest=-4h | where dstport=22 OR lower(coalesce(service,""))="ssh" | eval heure=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H")) | eval hors_horaires_flag=if(heure<8 OR heure>18,1,0) | eval statut_action=case( action="allowed","autorise", action="block" OR action="blocked","non_autorise", action="teardown","fin_session", 1=1,"autre" ) | stats count(eval(statut_action="autorise")) as autorisees count(eval(statut_action="non_autorise")) as ssh_bloquees sum(hors_horaires_flag) as hors_horaires dc(dstip) as destinations_ssh by srcip | eval decisions=autorisees+ssh_bloquees | where decisions>=20 AND ssh_bloquees>=10 | eval ratio_non_autorise=round((ssh_bloquees/decisions)*100,2) | where ratio_non_autorise>=80 | eval score_volume=case( decisions<50,5, decisions<200,10, decisions<1000,15, 1=1,20 ) | eval score_blocage=case( ssh_bloquees<25,5, ssh_bloquees<50,10, ssh_bloquees<100,15, 1=1,20 ) | eval score_ratio=case( ratio_non_autorise<85,10, ratio_non_autorise<95,20, 1=1,30 ) | eval score_destinations=case( destinations_ssh<3,5, destinations_ssh<10,10, destinations_ssh<30,15, 1=1,20 ) | eval score_horaires=case( hors_horaires=0,0, hors_horaires<10,3, hors_horaires<50,7, 1=1,10 ) | eval score_risque_ssh=score_volume+score_blocage+score_ratio+score_destinations+score_horaires | eval score_risque_ssh=if(score_risque_ssh>100,100,score_risque_ssh) | eval niveau_risque=case( score_risque_ssh<30,"Faible", score_risque_ssh<60,"Moyen", score_risque_ssh<80,"Élevé", 1=1,"Critique" ) | sort - score_risque_ssh | head 20 | table srcip niveau_risque score_risque_ssh ratio_non_autorise decisions ssh_bloquees destinations_ssh hors_horaires
